title: Savant Sommelier
lead: Wine intelligence — discover, learn, track, and analyze vineyard potential with explanations.
mission: Help people learn wine, find wine, track wine, and understand what could grow on a property today and decades ahead — without Vivino-clone pretension.
principles: No influencer scores or competitive tasting boards
Property details stay private by default
Future climate horizons are labeled scenarios, not precision forecasts

modules.title: Discover
modules.description: Explore grapes, regions, and styles with why / flavors / similar / price context.

modules.title: Learn
modules.description: Interactive curriculum covering grapes, climate, production, service, and tasting.

modules.title: My Cellar
modules.description: Local inventory, drink windows, ratings, notes, wishlist — empty until you add bottles.

modules.title: Vineyard Intelligence
modules.description: Property metrics with why-it-matters plus Future Vineyard horizons.

modules.title: Buying architecture
modules.description: Retailer / price / availability seams — not live marketplace.

modules.title: Map overlays
modules.description: Parcel, soils, hydrology, climate, terrain contracts — no unfinished overlays rendered.

dataModel: Educational catalogs ship as JSON. Cellar, sites, wishlist, and settings stay in localStorage. No sample cellar inventory.
privacyPhilosophy: Sites, wineries, and wines stay local. Property privacy is the default — not an afterthought.
futureDirection: Authoritative DEM/climate layers, parcel soils, live retailer adapters, and friends’ recommendations — always with honesty labels.
